snippet.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Heroes | Xbox | 2003 | Video Game US Trailer | LQ/OGR
snippet.description:
US Trailer for the Dungeons & Dragons: Heroes video game.

Published in United States by Atari in 2003 for Xbox
Developed by Atari Interactive Hunt Valley Studio

Trailer in high quality. Upscaled from the Trailer in original resolution.
Original source of the video is GameSpot.
